data.hook: Rookie defensive tackle Landon Robinson stepped onto the Paycor Stadium field in his full Navy service dress uniform, drawing cheers before his first NFL snap.
data.name: Bengals Defense Forces Four Turnovers in 33-27 Season-Opening Win Over Buccaneers
data.summary: Cincinnati opened the 2026 season with a 33-27 victory over Tampa Bay, powered by a revamped defense that forced four turnovers, including three first-half fumbles from Baker Mayfield that led to touchdowns. Joe Burrow went 25-for-35 for 254 yards and a touchdown, while Evan McPherson nailed field goals from 55 and 58 yards. Tampa Bay fought back with a pick-six and late score from rookie linebacker Josiah Trotter, but the Bengals ran out the clock to secure their second straight Week 1 win.

data.hook: On his first day as a CBS Sports analyst, Russell Wilson dropped a bombshell: Joe Burrow could bolt from Cincinnati if the season sours.
data.name: Russell Wilson Predicts Joe Burrow May Leave Bengals
data.summary: Wilson, fresh off retirement and joining 'The NFL Today' panel, said ahead of the Bengals' Week 1 game against Tampa Bay, 'If it doesn’t go well this year, Joe Burrow is gone. I think he wants to leave.' The comment fueled online backlash, with fans labeling it ragebait and critics questioning CBS's hire, though Burrow has reaffirmed his commitment, stating 'I’m here for the long haul' while under contract through 2029. Cincinnati faces pressure after three straight playoff misses, but recent roster moves and Burrow's optimism signal high stakes for 2026.

data.name: Buccaneers and Bengals Reveal Key Injuries Ahead of Week 1 Clash
data.summary: The Bengals list defensive end Shemar Stewart as doubtful and inactive, but Ja'Marr Chase, Tee Higgins, and cornerback DJ Turner are fully cleared to play. Tampa Bay rules out wide receiver Jalen McMillan, running back Sean Tucker, and several linemen, though rookie Emeka Egbuka is good to go after practicing fully. Linebacker Christian Rozeboom shakes off a foot injury for his debut, as the teams lean on their top talent in Cincinnati at 1 p.m. ET.

data.hook: Fantasy owners watched in disbelief as Ja'Marr Chase caught just two passes for 12 yards, despite high expectations in the Bengals' home opener.
data.name: Ja'Marr Chase's Quiet Day Steals Spotlight in Bengals Win
data.summary: Cincinnati beat Tampa Bay 33-27 at Paycor Stadium, with Joe Burrow going 25-of-35 for 254 yards, a touchdown, and an interception. Chase saw only four targets, falling way short of projections around 85 yards, while teammates like Tee Higgins and Mike Gesicki got more looks. Fans vented frustration in real time, with one saying he was 'ruining everyone’s hopes and dreams' and another noting they 'just woke up from a nap' to his meager stats.

data.hook: Sideline cameras caught Bengals coach Al Golden in a black pullover and visor, but the FOX chyron kept calling him 'FIRSTNAME LASTNAME OFFENSIVE COORDINATOR' – even with the score tied 0-0.
data.name: FOX Broadcast Labels Bengals Coach 'Firstname Lastname' in Week 1 Gaffe
data.summary: During the Bengals' 33-27 home win over the Buccaneers, a glaring graphic error misidentified defensive coordinator Al Golden – a veteran coach since 2025 – as the offensive coordinator with a placeholder name. The mistake flashed multiple times in the first quarter, prompting fans to share screenshots and jokes like 'truly week 1 for everybody.' Reporter Brett McMurphy noted the irony for the once-prominent college coach, now forever 'Firstname Lastname' in memes.

data.name: Ohio State Fans Eye Tough Three-Game Big Ten Stretch

Now 1-1 after a loss at Texas, the Buckeyes face these contenders amid fan debates—some predict a clean 3-0 sweep, others see Indiana slaying them or at least one upset looming. This stretch could define their playoff hopes as they rebound under Ryan Day.

data.name: Bengals Rookie Landon Robinson Arrives in Full Navy Uniform for NFL Debut
data.summary: The 23-year-old Ohio native, a seventh-round Bengals pick and Marine Corps second lieutenant, earned his roster spot with a stellar Navy career and dominant preseason featuring four sacks. Though inactive against the Buccaneers, his formal entrance drew praise from the NFL's account, Jordan Schultz, and fans as one of the day's strongest pregame looks. The moment blended military pride and rookie grit, especially poignant near the 9/11 anniversary.

data.name: Jalen Hurts Drops 'Smooth Criminal' Hype Video Before Eagles Opener
data.summary: The Philadelphia Eagles quarterback shared the rare black-and-white clip on Instagram late Friday, aligning with his recent posts on mindset and chasing greatness like 'A champion’s walk.' It ramps up excitement for Sunday's home opener against the Washington Commanders at 4:25 p.m. ET, under new offensive coordinator Sean Mannion after last season's playoff exit. While supporters see championship focus, some critics recirculate past lowlights, but Eagles fans defend his playoff leadership.
